abstract: Framework-neutral Java/JVM development agent skill covering plain Java, libraries, CLI tools, API design, exception handling, Java version modernization, Maven and Gradle build hygiene, optional Spring Boot development and migrations, Java code/security review, testing with JUnit/Mockito/Testcontainers, and JVM troubleshooting. Defaults are project-aware: preserve existing stack, build tool, Java version, logging, persistence, and Lombok usage unless the user asks to change them.

codeStyle.di: constructor injection in DI frameworks; use @RequiredArgsConstructor only when Lombok is already present
codeStyle.logging: use the existing logging facade; SLF4J-compatible logging preferred
codeStyle.dataClasses: prefer record for compatible Java DTOs; otherwise use immutable/final classes when practical
codeStyle.javaBaseline: preserve existing target; use newer syntax only when the project toolchain supports it or the user requests modernization
codeStyle.springBootDefault: optional framework domain; preserve existing Spring Boot line; verify current supported line and Java/Jakarta requirements for new or unknown examples
codeStyle.buildTool: preserve existing build tool; Maven and Gradle are both supported
codeStyle.persistence: preserve existing persistence choice; select MyBatis-Plus, JPA/Hibernate, JDBC, jOOQ, or another stack from project context, team preference, and data/query constraints
codeStyle.apiCompatibility: preserve public API/source/binary/serialization compatibility unless a breaking change is requested
codeStyle.exceptions: preserve causes, respect interrupts, map failures at system boundaries
